purpose: Win32 window implementation for the Notepad++ dockable preview panel; hosts WebViewHost and handles WM_SIZE and WM_ACTIVATE.
calls_out_to: RegisterClassExW / CreateWindowExW — creates the dockable child window
SendMessageW(nppHandle, NPPM_DMMREGASDCKDLG) — registers with Notepad++ docking system
SendMessageW(nppHandle, NPPM_DMMSHOW/HIDE) — shows/hides via Npp dock manager
invariants: Window is always a WS_CHILD of the Notepad++ main window
WM_ACTIVATE with WA_ACTIVE or WA_CLICKACTIVE triggers WebViewHost::Reload to fix WebView2 blank-content bug on reactivation
gotchas: WM_ACTIVATE handler calls webView_.Reload() to work around a WebView2 issue where the render surface goes blank after the host window loses and regains focus
DMN_CLOSE (1051) is a Notepad++ docking notification sent when the user closes the panel — must call onClose_ callback to update plugin menu check state
